scope: Post-run descriptive analysis of all frozen arms; zero additional inference or selection for retesting.

baseline.prompt: Compute 8 + 9. If the result is 17 answer A; if it is 16 answer B. Output only the letter.
Compute 7 * 6. If the result is 41 answer A; if it is 42 answer B. Output only the letter.
The vase is blue. A means the vase is blue; B means it is red. Output only the correct letter.
Choose the word that comes first alphabetically: A means zebra; B means apple. Output only the letter.
Which integer is smaller? A means 14; B means 19. Output only the letter.
A box contains exactly three coins. A means two coins; B means three coins. Output only the true letter.
Return the letter A and nothing else.
Return the letter B and nothing else.
